title: Meeting Assistant configuration
description: ~/Library/Application Support/MeetingAssistant/config.json. Read by the Swift app and the Python pipeline. Every key is optional; a missing key falls back to its default.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Bump on incompatible changes.

userName.description: Your name as colleagues say it (finds your tasks and mentions). Empty = the first name of the macOS account.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the detector checks running apps, windows and audio.

detectionConfirmSeconds.description: How long meeting signals must hold before the app asks whether to record (filters out short notification sounds).

endSilenceMinutes.description: Probable end of a meeting: the main signal (audio output for Teams and Discord, the Meet window for Google Meet) has been missing for this long.

minDurationMinutes.description: Recordings shorter than this are offered for discarding (notification Zahodit / Ponechat).

frameIntervalSeconds.description: How often a frame of the meeting window is checked for a significant change.

frameMaxDimension.description: Saved frames are scaled down so that the longer side is at most this many pixels.

frameChangeThreshold.description: Share of the perceptual hash (0–1) that must change before a new frame is saved. Lower = more frames.

audioRetentionDays.description: Audio files older than this are offered for deletion.

storageLimitGB.description: Disk space limit for all recordings of the app.

obsidianVaultPath.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault. Empty = not configured yet.

recordMicrophone.description: Record your microphone into mic.m4a (a separate track, aligned with the meeting audio).

microphoneName.description: Microphone recorded into mic.m4a: the first input device whose name contains this text. Empty = the system's default input.

pipelinePath.description: The Python pipeline project folder; `~` is expanded. Empty = the pipeline folder of the repository the app was built from.

uvPath.description: Full path of the uv executable (GUI apps do not see the shell PATH); `~` is expanded. Empty = found in ~/.local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin.
